analysis: PSS/SSS versus persisted GLRT64 on aligned 20 ms probes

configuration.conditional_probe_statistic: mean normalized matched-filter power at the containing one-second fit
configuration.pss_statistic: maximum over lag/CFO of mean per-frame normalized matched-filter power; divided by median lag score
configuration.sss_statistic: same statistic on the eight-subcarrier narrow SSS slice

wrong_edge_pss_search.description: upper-edge band-limited PSS template searched on the lower-edge stream-0/RX0 capture with the identical lag/CFO grid

limitations: GLRT labels are silver reference labels, not external truth.
PSS and SSS each contribute only an 11-sample narrowband slice at 2.5 MS/s.
Conditional 20 ms PSS/SSS scores reuse the one-second acquisition fit and are not whole-search calibrated detector statistics.
The SSS fit uses only eight edge subcarriers, not the full 240 MHz SSS.
Only the mixed active/quiet stream-0/RX0 path is compared; other paths are not pooled.
No payload is decoded and no spacecraft identity is claimed.

source_binding.pss_authority: Humphreys et al. 2023 equations 35-37 via leo-tracker numerical oracle
source_binding.sss_authority: Humphreys et al. 2023 equations 38-40 via leo-tracker numerical oracle
